5059442204632.sourceDescription:
A pot-grown Noble Fir has a distinctive tiered shape, with well-spaced, sturdy branches that create a naturally full Christmas tree. Its dark green foliage features a subtle blue tinge, while the soft, flat needles give the tree a fuller appearance and make decorating comfortable and easy. The branches are strong enough to hold lights, baubles, and other decorations, while good needle retention helps the tree stay fresh throughout the festive period. A slightly spicy, festive fragrance completes the traditional real Christmas-tree experience without overpowering the room.
DECORATE WITH CONFIDENCE: The sturdy branches of this Noble Fir provide good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations, while the well-spaced tiers leave room to show them off. Its soft, flat foliage is also more comfortable to handle while decorating and won't scratch little hands.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
FRESH, FESTIVE LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Noble Fir has a slightly spicy fragrance that adds a distinctive festive note without being overpowering. Its good needle retention also helps it stay fresh throughout the Christmas period, so the tree continues to look and smell the part as the celebrations unfold.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR THE GARDEN: Once the festive season is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue to care for it as it grows. With their year-round colour, Noble Firs make excellent evergreen trees for garden structure.
VIBRANT POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE TO ENJOY YEAR AFTER YEAR: Bring the Noble Fir indoors again for future Christmases, returning it outdoors afterwards so it can continue to grow. With the right care, you can grow a Christmas tree that becomes a familiar part of your Christmas traditions year after year.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

5059574914232.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red. Quantity: 15 pack.
Includes a 15-pack of festive red plastic ornaments for versatile Christmas decorating.
Features a sparkling glitter finish that catches the light and adds texture to displays.
Designed with detailed aesthetics to serve as a focal point in coordinated holiday arrangements.
Versatile decorative pieces suitable for enhancing home interiors during the Christmas season.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 15 pack

Product Overview

 This gold glitter snow‑flake tree topper is a decorative projector light specially made for Christmas tree tops. 
 Equipped with built‑in LED projection module (UK power plug), it casts dynamic white snowflake patterns onto ceilings and walls. 
 The farther away from the ceiling, the larger the projection scope. 
 Its conical base fits most standard Christmas trees, bringing dreamy snowing festive atmosphere for Christmas celebration.

Product Specifications

 Main shape: 3D Gold Glitter Snowflake Tree Topper
 Size: 10 inch × 10 inch; Insert base: 3.9 inch height, 1.97 inch inner width
 Light source: LED, pure white snowflake projection effect
 Power supply: UK plug power adapter, cable length 6.56 Ft
 Material: Light‑weight glitter hard plastic
 Projection effect: Rotating dynamic white snowflake patterns
 Package contents: Snowflake tree topper, UK‑spec power adapter, gift box

Application Scenarios

 Home Christmas decoration: Place on top of indoor Christmas tree for family holiday parties
 Commercial scene: Bar, restaurant, retail shop, office, shopping mall festive decor
 Ideal Christmas gift for family and friends

Notes

 Designed for indoor use only, do not use outdoors.
 Adjust installation height: further distance from ceiling brings bigger projection range.
 Conical holder fits most Christmas tree tops; check tree‑top thickness before installation.
 Keep power adapter away from water and damp environment.
Perfect Christmas Decoration - The unique shiny star-shaped Christmas tree topper adopts hollow design and is equipped with built-in 3D rotating snowflake projection lights. Highlight the strong Christmas atmosphere and enjoy a happy Christmas with family or friends.
❄️3D 360° Rotating Projector - Paired with high-quality LED projector lights, 360° rotating dynamic snowflake patterns are projected on the ceiling, like a vivid snow scene. Spend a different Christmas with your family enjoying the dancing snowflakes.
Star Tree Topper Size & Material - Christmas star tree topper size is 10 x 3.9 x 10 inches (L x W x H). Made of lightweight material so that it can be stably fixed on the top of the tree, with glittering silver powder on the surface (safe and non-toxic, please allow slight falling).
Projection Range & Multiple Scene Usage - The farther the tree topper with light is from the ceiling, the larger the projection range. Perfect for home, office, shopping mall, restaurant, party, bar and other occasions.
Ideal Gift for Christmas - The Christmas tree star topper comes with a gift box, which is an ideal choice for family, children and friends at Christmas. Decorate your Christmas tree and elevate your holiday experience with the perfect blend of elegance and innovation.

4313817027532.sourceDescription:
Versatile Decor & Perfect Gift Idea
Equipped with a hook, this charming hot air balloon light can be easily hung in bedrooms, living rooms, patios, or even
cafes and garden pergolas,. It's not just for Christmas – it adds a touch of whimsy to birthdays, weddings, baby showers,
or everyday home decor. Thoughtfully designed and universally loved, it makes a wonderful Christmas gift for family, friends,
and anyone who appreciates a little holiday magic.
Magical Design & Festive Atmosphere
This enchanting hot air balloon lamp features a classic red and white striped balloon and a delightful Santa Claus figurine
sitting in the woven basket. It instantly transforms any room into a cozy winter wonderland, filling your space with the magic
and joy of Christmas. Whether placed on a mantel, hung from the window, or displayed near the Christmas tree, this stunning
piece captures the holiday spirit like no other.
Product Specifications
Product Name: LED Santa Claus Hot Air Balloon
Product Dimensions: 30 × 21 × 100 cm
Batteries: 3 AAA batteries (not included)
Light Colors: Warm light
Protection Rating: IP44
【Magical Christmas Decoration】: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this unique hot air balloon lantern. Featuring classic red and white striped balloons and a charming Santa Claus figure nestled in the woven basket, this Christmas lamp instantly becomes the focal point of any room. The warm, inviting glow creates a cozy fairy-tale atmosphere that both kids and adults will adore, making it the ultimate Holiday Decoration for your living room, mantel, or entryway.
【8 Lighting Modes & Timer Function】: Easily switch among 8 dynamic lighting effects – steady on, slow fade, twinkling, chasing, wave, and more – with the button on the battery case. Adjust the brightness level to suit any mood, from a soft nightlight to a brilliant festive glow. The default timer is preset to automatically turn the lights on for 6 hours, then off for 18 hours in a repeating cycle, so you never need to worry about manual shut‑off. This smart cycle saves battery and lets the lamp run effortlessly while you sleep or go out, making it simple to personalise your holiday ambiance.
【Battery-Powered】: Say goodbye to messy cords and limited outlets! Powered by 3 AA batteries (not included), this lamp is completely wireless. What sets it apart is the upgraded waterproof battery case, which protects the power source from light rain or snow. This means you can safely display it on your front porch, patio, or balcony without worrying about the elements—bringing festive cheer both indoors and outdoors.
【Versatile Decoration for Any Space】: This charming hot air balloon light comes with a handy hook, making it incredibly easy to hang wherever you like. Suspend it in your bedroom for a dreamy nightlight, display it in the living room as a festive centerpiece, or hang it on the patio to welcome guests with a warm glow. Its classic design blends seamlessly into any setting, adding a touch of sparkling brilliance to Christmas.
【The Perfect Christmas Gift for All Ages】: Looking for a special present? This whimsical balloon light is the ideal Christmas Gift for family, friends, neighbors, or even as a hostess gift for holiday parties. It’s a thoughtful and unique surprise that spreads joy long after the holidays are over. Perfect for teens, adults, and seniors who appreciate a touch of holiday magic.

5075660326932.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: PVC. Quantity: 1 piece.
Self-adhesive backing allows for quick and secure attachment to compatible surfaces without the need for additional tools.
Water-resistant construction ensures durability in environments where occasional moisture is present, maintaining its appearance.
Festive Christmas elf design adds a charming decorative detail to holiday displays and seasonal home arrangements.
Compact single-piece ornament provides a flexible finishing touch that can be easily repositioned within your decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Outdoor use
Shatterproof
Included: Self-adhesive backing

8941467526332.variantName: 10 Pack Red Velvet Christmas Bows 9 x 13 in Large Wreath Bow Gold Glitter Edge for Tree Stairs Fireplace Door
8941467526332.sourceDescription:
These Christmas bows are made from velvet with a gold wired edge, and a fine iron wire runs through the rim so a squashed bow can be eased back into shape by hand and will not wither. Each bow is handmade, and the glitter string adds a soft sparkle against the red velvet.

Each bow measures approximately 9 x 13 in (23 x 33 cm), a large size that stands out clearly on a door, a tree or a wreath. The wired edge also lets you open out the loops and tails and set the shape you want, so every bow keeps its fullness after being stored away, and the same classic look can be repeated across a whole room.

Tie them onto wreaths, Christmas trees, windows, doors, walls, stairs, fences and fireplaces, or use them around the home, office, garden, party, wedding or picnic. They work indoors and outdoors alike, for daily decorating as well as the Christmas season, and ten bows in one pack are enough to dress a front door, a stair rail and a tree in a matching style, with a few spare for next year.

Velvet in a deep red, lifted by the gold edge, sits comfortably beside tartan ribbon, greenery and warm white fairy lights, so one pack can carry the same accent from the front door through to the tree, the mantelpiece and the presents underneath.

They also make a practical crafting gift for friends who enjoy DIY, or a finishing touch on wrapped presents for family, a partner, relatives or colleagues.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, metal, and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Wood, Metal, and Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 60 cm. Product weight: 0.9 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Built-in timer function allows you to set and organise the operating period for convenient automated festive lighting.
Features realistic pine cone details that add texture and create a woodland-inspired arrangement among the green foliage.
Constructed from durable wood, metal, and plastic materials to provide a defined appearance and long-lasting festive decoration.
Compact 60 cm green wreath design serves as an ideal focal point for doors or walls without overwhelming surrounding decor.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

 Fireplace mantel, living‑room wall, hallway, window frame

The EVRE Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath with Golden Accents is a 60 cm (24-inch) artificial wreath with lifelike greenery, pine cones, red berries and gold leaves, pre-strung with 50 LED lights for a warm festive glow. It runs on batteries with a built-in daily timer, so there is no plug or cable to hide, making it easy to hang above a fireplace, on a wall or on a sheltered front door, and it can be stored away and used again for Christmas after Christmas.
Pre-lit 60 cm (24 inch) artificial Christmas wreath with 50 LED lights, pine cones, red berries and gold leaves.
Battery operated with no plug or cable: runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included). Built-in timer: 6 hours on, 18 hours off, every day.
116 mixed PVC and PE tips for a full, rounded shape. Use indoors or on a sheltered front door. Keep the battery box dry.

There is no metal frame or hanger, so hang it with ribbon, string or a wreath hook through the branches.
Reusable: store it in a cool, dry place after Christmas and use it again next year. Clean with a damp cloth.
Safety: for decorative use only. Keep away from fires, heaters and naked flames, and keep small parts away from young children and pets.
Fittings & fixings included
